summary: Mangoceuticals (Mango), a Texas company, entered into a Business Combination Agreement with Nuclea Energy, a British Columbia corporation, on July 29, 2026. Under the deal, a Mango subsidiary amalgamates with Nuclea, and Nuclea shareholders receive exchangeable shares of a Mango subsidiary, exchangeable one-for-one into Mango common stock. The exchange ratio implies former Nuclea shareholders hold ~96% of Mango's fully diluted equity, with existing Mango holders retaining ~4%. The two-stage closing occurs before required approvals, with a Nasdaq Cap limiting exchangeable rights to 19.99% until stockholder and Nasdaq approvals. A concurrent PIPE financing is included. Watch for regulatory approvals, Nasdaq listing, and shareholder approval; the structure resembles a reverse merger with exchangeable shares.
